title: 'Painting Animals from Life' releases tomorrow
content: (Link to Facebook video)Here's a video teaser for tomorrow’s release of “Painting Animals from Life.”Shari Blaukopfsays: "It's magic to watch his paintings develop from big, loose shapes to finished pieces, and there's much to be learned from his thoughtful narration which includes anecdotes about his models as well as lessons in color, anatomy and perspective.”----69 minutes Widescreen, MP4 video.Digital downloadGumroadSellfyCubebrushDVDDirect from manufacturer KunakiDVD at Amazon
